title: Email::new constructor takes HashMap<Id,bool> by value — ergonomic gap
description: Email::new requires callers to construct a HashMap<Id,bool> before calling new. For the 90% case (one mailbox), this is: let mut m = HashMap::new(); m.insert(id, true); Email::new(..., m, ...). A helper like Email::in_mailbox(mailbox_id) or accepting an impl IntoIterator<Item=(Id,bool)> would reduce friction without changing the type. Since nobody depends on this yet, this is a good time to improve ergonomics. Alternatively, a dedicated MailboxSet type (backed by HashSet<Id>) would be more expressive than HashMap<Id,bool>.
